resources.string: Install Codex from Tools. For first use, sign in with the command below in this distribution’s terminal.
The next message starts a new Codex conversation. The previous history stays in Codex.
Leaving closes the current Codex process and stops the turn.
Codex reported a failed turn. Check the login and sandbox in the terminal.
Codex is signed out in this distribution. Sign in from the project terminal.
The Codex process exited. Check that this distribution has a compatible Codex CLI.
Codex returned a different sandbox or approval policy. The turn was not sent.
Codex chat requires a registered project in the local workspace.
The current distribution is missing. Set up the Linux environment first.
Could not restore the Codex conversation. Reload or start a new conversation.
Could not save the Codex conversation link.
Codex did not respond in time. Check the CLI status.
The Codex request failed. Check the CLI version and conversation state.
